name: testanyware-discovery
purpose: Observe implicit discovery of a skill from a source that is not a Linkuistics pack (testanyware-skill-move-k172). A Grove impl leaf asks for a script that screenshots a GUI app in an isolated VM, and it names no skill. The grove source comes from the prepared Grove checkout, and the testanyware source from a plain Git checkout of a published TestAnyware commit. Expect a read of using-testanyware/SKILL.md from the testanyware snapshot before the script is written. No VM starts. The offline resolution then gives the descriptor identity of the launch.
